result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the system home indicator overlaps the bottom navigation bar icons.

issues.description: The OS home indicator bar at the bottom of the screen overlaps directly with the middle navigation icons (Search and Orders) in the bottom tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) to the bottom navigation bar container so the icons sit comfortably above the system home indicator.
